nodes.name: Units Per Tenant
nodes.notes: Reads back WHICH dealership each recomputed row belongs to, so the audit trail can be split per tenant. Same predicate as the function's own subquery (acquired_at is not null), so the counts describe exactly the rows the sweep touched. Fails soft: on error 'Group By Tenant' emits a single TENANT UNRESOLVED row rather than losing the audit trail for the night.

nodes.name: Group By Tenant
nodes.notes: Added 2 Sep 2026. Turns the platform-wide sweep into one audit row per dealership.
